declarations.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.IsNoncriticalBelyi
declarations.source_signature: def IsNoncriticalBelyi (hs : List ElemMap) (S : Set Pt) (τ : Pt) : Prop

readbacks.en: Use the full algebraic closure Q̄ of ℚ. A projective point is either ∞ or a finite point some(x), with x ∈ Q̄. The distinguished set is B = {∞, some(0), some(1)}. An elementary map has one of two forms: a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), where a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0; or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] with 0 < natDegree(p). At a finite point, a zero Möbius denominator gives ∞. At ∞, a Möbius map gives ∞ when c=0, and some(a/c) otherwise. A polynomial sends some(x) to some(p(x)) and ∞ to ∞. A Möbius map has index 1 at every point. A polynomial has index natDegree(p) at ∞; at some(x), its index is the root multiplicity of x in p mapped to Q̄[X] minus the constant polynomial p(x). For a finite list h = [h₁,…,hₖ], F_h applies h₁ first and hₖ last. Thus F_[] is the identity and F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)). Its index is R_[]=1 and R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)); equivalently, multiply the elementary indices at successive images of z. Write P(h,A,t) for exactly these three conditions: every z ∈ A satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B; F_h(t) ∉ B; and every projective point z with 1 < R_h(z) satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B. For every finite list hs of these elementary maps, every set S of projective points, and every projective point τ, define IsNoncriticalBelyi(hs,S,τ) to mean P(hs,S,τ). The definition is exactly the conjunction above.
readbacks.zh_Hans: 取有理数域的完整代数闭包 Q̄。射影点是无穷远点 ∞，或者有限点 some(x)，其中 x∈Q̄。指定集合为 B={∞,some(0),some(1)}。初等映射有两类：有理系数的 Möbius 映射 (az+b)/(cz+d)，其中 a,b,c,d∈ℚ 且 ad−bc≠0；以及有理系数多项式 p，其自然数次数严格大于零。Möbius 映射在有限点的分母为零时取值 ∞；在 ∞ 处，当 c=0 时取值 ∞，否则取值 some(a/c)。多项式把 some(x) 映到 some(p(x))，把 ∞ 映到 ∞。Möbius 映射在每一点的分歧指数为 1。多项式在 ∞ 的分歧指数为其自然数次数；在 some(x) 的分歧指数为 x 在多项式 p 的系数嵌入 Q̄ 后减去常数多项式 p(x) 所得多项式中的根重数。对有限列表 h=[h₁,…,hₖ]，复合 F_h 先作用 h₁，最后作用 hₖ。因此 F_[] 为恒等映射，F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z))。复合分歧指数满足 R_[]=1 和 R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z))，即沿逐次像相乘。记 P(h,A,t) 为以下三个条件的合取：每个 z∈A 都满足 F_h(z)∈B；F_h(t)∉B；每个满足 1<R_h(z) 的射影点 z 都满足 F_h(z)∈B。对上述初等映射的每个有限列表 hs、射影点的每个集合 S，以及每个射影点 τ，定义 IsNoncriticalBelyi(hs,S,τ) 为 P(hs,S,τ)，即上述三个条件的合取。
readbacks.ja: 有理数体の全代数閉包を Q̄ とする。射影点は無限遠点 ∞ または有限点 some(x)（x∈Q̄）である。指定集合を B={∞,some(0),some(1)} とする。初等写像は、有理数係数のメビウス変換 (az+b)/(cz+d)（a,b,c,d∈ℚ、ad−bc≠0）、または自然数次数が正の有理数係数多項式 p のいずれかである。メビウス変換は有限点で分母が零なら ∞ を与え、∞ では c=0 なら ∞、そうでなければ some(a/c) を与える。多項式は some(x) を some(p(x)) に、∞ を ∞ に写す。メビウス変換の分岐指数は各点で 1 である。多項式の分岐指数は ∞ でその自然数次数、some(x) では p の係数を Q̄ に移した多項式から定数多項式 p(x) を引いた多項式における x の根の重複度である。有限リスト h=[h₁,…,hₖ] の合成 F_h は h₁ を最初に、hₖ を最後に作用させる。従って F_[] は恒等写像であり、F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)) となる。合成分岐指数は R_[]=1、R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)) であり、逐次得られる像での指数を掛け合わせる。P(h,A,t) は次の三条件の連言を表す。A の各点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。F_h(t)∉B が成り立つ。さらに、1<R_h(z) を満たすすべての射影点 z で F_h(z)∈B が成り立つ。上記の初等写像のすべての有限リスト hs、射影点のすべての集合 S、およびすべての射影点 τ に対し、IsNoncriticalBelyi(hs,S,τ) を P(hs,S,τ)、すなわち上記三条件の連言として定義する。

For a finite subset T of Q̄, Galois stability means that every ℚ-algebra automorphism σ:Q̄→Q̄ sends every member of T into T. No restriction to a chosen finite extension or rational points occurs. readbacks.en: Use the full algebraic closure Q̄ of ℚ. A projective point is either ∞ or a finite point some(x), with x ∈ Q̄. The distinguished set is B = {∞, some(0), some(1)}. An elementary map has one of two forms: a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), where a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0; or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] with 0 < natDegree(p). At a finite point, a zero Möbius denominator gives ∞. At ∞, a Möbius map gives ∞ when c=0, and some(a/c) otherwise. A polynomial sends some(x) to some(p(x)) and ∞ to ∞. A Möbius map has index 1 at every point. A polynomial has index natDegree(p) at ∞; at some(x), its index is the root multiplicity of x in p mapped to Q̄[X] minus the constant polynomial p(x). For a finite list h = [h₁,…,hₖ], F_h applies h₁ first and hₖ last. Thus F_[] is the identity and F_(u::h)(z)=F_h(u(z)). Its index is R_[]=1 and R_(u::h)(z)=r_u(z)·R_h(u(z)); equivalently, multiply the elementary indices at successive images of z. Write P(h,A,t) for exactly these three conditions: every z ∈ A satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B; F_h(t) ∉ B; and every projective point z with 1 < R_h(z) satisfies F_h(z) ∈ B. Let S be any finite set of projective points over the full algebraic closure Q̄ of ℚ. Assume that every ℚ-algebra automorphism σ of Q̄ sends each z∈S back into S. Its action fixes ∞ and sends some(x) to some(σ(x)). Assume that the finite point some(0) does not belong to S. Then there exists a finite list hs of rational elementary maps with these properties. Every z∈S satisfies F_hs(z)∈{∞,some(0),some(1)}. The image F_hs(some(0)) lies outside that three-point set. For every projective point z, if 1<R_hs(z), then F_hs(z) belongs to that three-point set. The hypothesis permits ∞∈S and imposes no degree or norm bound. The excluded source point is specifically zero. The written combination proof depends on the three open sorry reduction steps, through the private general theorem.
